title: Implemenation of IAS 16 «Property, plant and equipment» in activity of entities of public interest
central_claims: Comparison of Ukrainian AP(S)7 with IAS16 identifies differences in recognition, classification, valuation, revaluation and depreciation.
The proposed accounting comparisons and revaluation process can support transition of public-interest entities to international accounting practice.

source_manifest.title: Implemenation of IAS 16 «Property, plant and equipment» in activity of entities of public interest
source_manifest.finding: Compares national and international fixed-asset accounting, offers a revaluation sequence and describes financial-statement transformation; no post-publication validation is contained in this original.

search_gaps: Assigned DOI .01.052 resolves through Crossref to an obsolete publisher URL. Crossref also registers .02.052 for the same title; the migrated publisher and matching full English PDF use .02.052. Assigned metadata is preserved.

English and Ukrainian author/title/method searches found bibliographic copies and general standards material, but no independent paper-specific follow-up. Such retrieval absence is not proof of nonadoption.
research.summary: The original comparison and proposed accounting transition procedure were read in full. Independent validation and actual reuse remain unknown; general IAS16 adoption is not attributed to this paper.
